title: marketplace.yaml
description: Authored per marketplace under config/marketplaces/<slug>/. The executable source of truth is src/modules/marketplace-config/schema.ts; this document mirrors it for external consumers.

slug.description: Must equal the containing directory name.

domain.description: Canonical bare hostname, no protocol or path. May carry an explicit port for local development.

aliases.description: Hostnames that redirect to the canonical domain. Must not repeat the canonical domain, and must be unique across all marketplaces.

theme.description: Key into the shared theme token table.

questionnaire.description: Path to the questionnaire JSON, relative to this file.

matching.description: Path to the matching YAML, relative to this file.

defaultIndexing.description: Whether public pages are indexable in production. Never indexable outside production.
